scope: Actual CPU scheduler/helper and real sampled trajectories; no browser, GPU, optical-capacity, audio, performance or rendered-visibility acceptance

checks.name: library defaults remain manual/random-off with four complete slots
uniform interval helper handles edges and degenerate range
automatic one-to-five-second gaps vary and stay in configured interval
equal random endpoints collapse to fixed schedule without changing event choices
frame partitions preserve launch schedule, random aim, types and actual poses
signed aim maps negative/zero/positive and sixty-five-degree boundaries geometrically
automatic closed tilt intervals ignore manual cone and retain moved muzzle origin
asymmetric automatic tilt stays inside range with varied draws
manual launches retain ordinary cone independently of automatic tilt settings
thirty-two complete events are admitted and thirty-third immediately rejects without queue
automatic one-second show can exceed four concurrent complete events
repeated true/UI echo does not reset scheduled launch or add a current-time launch
interval reconfigure schedules future slot while stop retains airborne event
invalid range edits are atomic including schedule and subsequent random sequence
very large clock catch-up is bounded and leaves no deferred backlog
